children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: To establish undeniable identity and essential financial context before engaging in deep workflows, ensuring a high-trust environment for all participants.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does identity verification prove investment capacity?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Identity verification and financial capacity represent different trust layers within the platform infrastructure. Both are necessary but serve distinct structural purposes.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: It is the structured framework that filters opportunities based on defined parameters: target sectors, development stages, geographical focus, typical ticket size, and structural preferences.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Defining typical deployment ranges accurately aligns funding needs with the investor's structural reality, optimizing the matching algorithm for relevant velocity.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Can I invest outside my thesis?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: Yes. The thesis exists to structure and guide automated discovery; it is a powerful utility, not a permanent legal restriction on your ultimate deployment decisions.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: What investment structures can be represented?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: The platform natively supports structural parameters for Equity, SAFE, Convertible Note, Debt, Revenue Share, and customized hybrid instruments.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Does a matched company mean Mondial recommends the investment?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. A match indicates high relevance based purely on the structural data criteria defined in your thesis. It is not an endorsement or financial recommendation.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
children.characters: Is all of my financial verification information public?

children.name: We offer both!
children.characters: No. Sensitive capacity and verification data remains entirely private within the platform infrastructure. Only the derived validation status is selectively exposed.

children.name: How long does it take to complete a landing page?
We offer both!
children.characters: Once your foundation is established, you transition into the Discover & Match phase to test your thesis against live market opportunities.
